title: Reader-to-actor handoff
description: Declares how an actor may act on a reader's report (checklist G-04). The reader's report_result must carry an output that validates against output_schema; each declared action builds a broker request whose params are literals or $output.<path> references to constrained (non-free-text) fields of that output. homelabnext.agent.handoff adds the checks JSON Schema cannot: the reader cannot act, the actor does not read untrusted content, every reference names a constrained field, and every action is in the broker manifest with a grant for the actor.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the report's output; must be a closed object (additionalProperties false).

params.description: param name -> a literal, or "$output.<path>"; "$$" escapes a literal "$".
